mentions.name: Go/SDL 2D top-down action puzzle game
mentions.description: A 2D top-down action puzzle game written in Go on top of SDL using the go-sdl2 bindings, built around the design prompt "Chip's Challenge meets Hotline Miami". Development graphics are assembled from purchased pixel-art asset packs, with plans to collaborate with an artist (or move to 3D/2.5D) if it is commercialized. The codebase is being organized into a reusable engine for top-down games such as RTS, TBS, tactics, and RPG titles.
